reviewed: Compact single-group window and file-first hierarchy
Original silhouette animals and opposing-clip app mark
No marketing hero, fake device chrome, gradients or nested cards
Shared OKLCH color and font tokens
Key text contrast pairs measured in contrast.json
Browser layout and interaction evidence in qa.json, desktop-qa.json, mobile-qa.json
scopeExceptions: Native CJK sans-serif for functional UI; upright serif for brand and short display text
Clickable file rows have multiline metadata; action labels remain single-line
Marketing hero, footer and video gates are not applicable
Portable SVG exports embed shared palette values
limitations: Not integrated into Electron, React Native or Ink production clients
Transfer, join and save are local simulations; clipboard is functional
Not a full element-by-element accessibility audit of every state
Wordmark needs outlines at finalization; icons need physical-device small-size review
verdict: Ready for prototype review, not claiming all 58 gates or production acceptance passed
